name: Clipboard
purpose: Copy a known text value through an explicit user action while coordinating editable or displayed value, truthful asynchronous status, latest-operation ownership, and authored accessible feedback.
useWhen: A user needs to copy a known command, URL, token, or code sample and the interface must report actual clipboard success or failure.

avoidWhen.condition: The task reads, pastes, cuts, or copies files or binary data, or a normal Button without copy status is sufficient.
avoidWhen.useInstead: an application-owned Clipboard API workflow or Button

composition: Compose Root around a stably named Trigger and authored Status feedback. Add Label with Input when the value is editable or exposed as a field, Control for structure, ValueText for read-only display, and state-specific Indicator parts inside Status as needed.

rules.statement: Start copying only from an intentional Trigger activation and preserve consumer preventDefault cancellation, secure-context, permission, and browser Clipboard API requirements.
Report copying, copied, and error only from the authoritative write result; never imply success when the API is unavailable or rejects.
Keep the newest copy attempt authoritative when earlier asynchronous writes settle later and reset copied or error state only after the configured timeout.
Give Trigger a stable accessible action name and put short authored success and failure wording in Status; Atom intentionally supplies no product strings.
Use Clipboard for text writes only and do not add deprecated execCommand fallbacks that can misreport behavior.

commonMistakes.mistake: Showing Copied immediately on click, swallowing permission errors, changing Trigger's accessible name unpredictably, or using Clipboard to read or transfer binary data.
commonMistakes.correction: Wait for the write result, expose error feedback, keep a stable action name, and use an application-owned workflow for unsupported clipboard operations.

validation: Verify controlled/uncontrolled value editing, Label/Input association, ValueText, disabled behavior, pointer and keyboard Trigger activation, consumer cancellation, custom writeValue adapter, secure-context or unavailable API error, success, rejection, and focus remaining on Trigger.

Verify idle/copying/copied/error Indicators, polite atomic Status announcements, timeout reset and cleanup, overlapping writes resolving and rejecting out of order, no stale status changes, native props, refs, and asChild/render semantics.
